description: Roman Alexeev is an introspective and self-sufficient individual with a strong sense of personal identity. He values his independence and prefers to maintain a calm, observant approach to life. While capable of adapting to new situations, he tends to rely on his own resourcefulness rather than seeking external help or advice. This self-reliance extends to his relationships, where he prefers to keep emotional involvement minimal, avoiding deep commitments in favor of a more casual and low-key social circle. His introspective nature makes him a thoughtful and reflective person, but also somewhat detached from the world around him.
